title: Matillion Job Freshness SLA
app: Matillion task API and component logs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=matillion:task state="SUCCESS"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by job_name
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>12
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Matillion job and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A job can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Matillion.
implementation: Ingest Matillion success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical job exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of job by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Matillion has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
